prompt: A scholarship reserved for white students can be morally acceptable.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
Yes, in some circumstances—for example, if it addresses documented disadvantage affecting a particular white community and the racial restriction is necessary and proportionate.

But being white alone is a weak justification for exclusive access. A scholarship based on financial need, location, or another relevant disadvantage will often serve the same purpose more fairly. The moral assessment depends on its purpose, effects, and whether less exclusionary alternatives would work.
